prompt: Audit website search and traffic performance, prepare email marketing/contact lists, and send outreach emails for marketing and press engagement.

results.use_case: Audit website search and traffic performance, prepare email marketing/contact lists, and send outreach emails for marketing and press engagement.
results.execution_guidance: IMPORTANT: Follow the recommended plan below. Extract steps before execution, adapt to your current context, execute sequentially with current_step parameter, and check known pitfalls to avoid errors.
recommended_plan_steps: [Required] [Prerequisite]: Retrieve available audiences using MAILCHIMP_GET_LISTS_INFO (capture only minimal identifiers/labels; if many, page with count/offset until total reached).
[Optional (if you must confirm settings/stats before writing)] [Step]: Validate the selected audience using MAILCHIMP_GET_LIST_INFO (ensure it matches intended use).
[Optional (if diagnosing unexpected member changes)] [Step]: Review recent list actions using MAILCHIMP_LIST_RECENT_ACTIVITY (sanity check before/after writes).
[Required] [Step]: Bulk add/update members using MAILCHIMP_BATCH_SUBSCRIBE_OR_UNSUBSCRIBE (set desired status; enable updating existing; include merge fields/tags only when needed).
[Optional (if the batch runs asynchronously)] [Next Step]: Monitor completion using MAILCHIMP_GET_BATCH_OPERATION_STATUS (treat changes as applied only when finished).

[Optional (if the batch has row-level failures or volume is small)] [Fallback]: Upsert only failed/few members using MAILCHIMP_ADD_OR_UPDATE_LIST_MEMBER (compute subscriber_hash; satisfy required merge-field schema).
[Optional (for QA/spot checks)] [Next Step]: Verify a sample using MAILCHIMP_SEARCH_MEMBERS or MAILCHIMP_LIST_MEMBERS_INFO (confirm expected status and key fields).
known_pitfalls: [MAILCHIMP_GET_LISTS_INFO] Audience list data is nested (not a simple top-level array); parse the nested list collection correctly.
[MAILCHIMP_GET_LISTS_INFO] Responses can be verbose and may include sensitive contact/profile fields; use fields/exclude_fields and retain only what’s needed.
[MAILCHIMP_BATCH_SUBSCRIBE_OR_UNSUBSCRIBE] Requests can succeed but still partially fail; check error_count and per-row errors before assuming all updates applied.
[MAILCHIMP_ADD_OR_UPDATE_LIST_MEMBER] subscriber_hash must be MD5 of a normalized (trimmed/lowercased) email; mismatches can cause failed/duplicate upserts.
[MAILCHIMP_ADD_OR_UPDATE_LIST_MEMBER] skip_merge_validation bypasses required merge-field checks; use only if invalid/incomplete profiles are acceptable.

MAILCHIMP_GET_LISTS_INFO.description: Get information about all lists in the account.

count.description: The number of records to return. Default value is 10. Maximum value is 1000

email.description: Restrict results to lists that include a specific subscriber"s email address.

fields.description: A comma-separated list of fields to return. Reference parameters of sub-objects with dot notation.

offset.description: Used for [pagination](https://mailchimp.com/developer/marketing/docs/methods-parameters/#pagination), this it the number of records from a collection to skip. Default value is 0.

sort_dir.description: Determines the order direction for sorted results.

sort_field.description: Returns files sorted by the specified field.

exclude_fields.description: A comma-separated list of fields to exclude. Reference parameters of sub-objects with dot notation.

since_date_created.description: Restrict results to lists created after the set date. Uses ISO 8601 time format: 2015-10-21T15:41:36+00:00.

before_date_created.description: Restrict response to lists created before the set date. Uses ISO 8601 time format: 2015-10-21T15:41:36+00:00.

has_ecommerce_store.description: Restrict results to lists that contain an active, connected, undeleted ecommerce store.

include_total_contacts.description: Return the total_contacts field in the stats response, which contains an approximate count of all contacts in any state.

since_campaign_last_sent.description: Restrict results to lists created after the last campaign send date. Uses ISO 8601 time format: 2015-10-21T15:41:36+00:00.

before_campaign_last_sent.description: Restrict results to lists created before the last campaign send date. Uses ISO 8601 time format: 2015-10-21T15:41:36+00:00.

MAILCHIMP_BATCH_SUBSCRIBE_OR_UNSUBSCRIBE.description: Batch subscribe or unsubscribe list members.

list_id.description: The unique ID for the list.

members.description: An array of member objects. Each object must contain 'email_address' (string) and 'status' (one of: 'subscribed', 'unsubscribed', 'cleaned', 'pending', 'transactional'). Optional fields include: 'merge_fields' (dict with field tags like FNAME, LNAME), 'tags' (list of tag names), 'vip' (bool), 'language' (string), 'email_type' ('html' or 'text'), 'ip_signup' and 'ip_opt' (strings). Up to 500 members may be added or updated with each API call.

sync_tags.description: Whether this batch operation will replace all existing tags with tags in request.

update_existing.description: Whether this batch operation will change existing members' subscription status and data. Set to true to update existing members, false to only add new members. Defaults to false.

skip_duplicate_check.description: If skip_duplicate_check is true, we will ignore duplicates sent in the request when using the batch sub/unsub on the lists endpoint. The status of the first appearance in the request will be saved. This defaults to false.

skip_merge_validation.description: If skip_merge_validation is true, member data will be accepted without merge field values, even if the merge field is usually required. This defaults to false.
